articles.title: Gomez injury overshadows winning start for Iraola
articles.summary: Liverpool start life under Andoni Iraola with a 4-2 win over Sunderland thanks to goals from Kieran Morrison, Dominik Szoboszlai, Federico Chiesa and Lewis Koumas.

articles.title: The defining moments of the 2026 World Cup
articles.summary: From historic World Cup debuts and emotional first victories, to new stars and the brilliance of legends - relive the defining moments of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.title: Watch the BBC's closing World Cup montage
articles.summary: Watch the closing montage of the BBC's coverage of the 2026 Fifa World Cup featuring all the highs, lows and colour from the biggest World Cup ever.

articles.title: Norris wins first race of 2026 as Hamilton suffers more penalty pain
articles.summary: Lando Norris won his first race of 2026 after an early squabble with McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri at the Hungarian Grand Prix.

articles.title: Malaysia added to 2026 F1 calendar
articles.summary: Formula 1 has added Malaysia to its 2026 schedule as the host of the Bahrain Grand Prix that was postponed earlier in the season.
